title: Two New Nashville Homes • Sleeps Up to 24
description:
Bring your whole crew to this charming West End Nashville retreat — two side-by-side homes with matching layouts and stylish furnishings, made for groups traveling together. You're less than a mile from Vanderbilt University and just 3 miles from Lower Broadway's honky-tonks, with easy access to Uber, Lyft, and scooters whenever you're ready to explore.

The space
Combined, the homes offer 8 private bedrooms and 8 ensuite bathrooms, comfortably sleeping up to 24 guests. Every suite comes thoughtfully equipped with luxury Helix mattresses, Smart TVs, hotel-quality linens, LED lighted makeup mirrors, premium bathroom amenities, luggage racks, and high-speed Wi-Fi.

Family reunion, friends' trip, or a celebration worth remembering — whatever brings you together, this spacious retreat delivers comfort, convenience, and Music City charm in equal measure.

NOTE: Expect some noise due to active construction happening right across the street.

HOME LAYOUT:
• 3 level home - 2 identical home layouts
• Open-concept kitchen, living, and dining area
• Bedroom 1: Queen bed with private bathroom
• Bedroom 2: Queen bed with private bathroom
• Bedroom 3: King bed with private bathroom
• Bedroom 4: Queen bed and twin over twin bunk bed with private bathroom
• Bedroom 5: Queen bed with private bathroom
• Bedroom 6: Queen bed with private bathroom
• Bedroom 7: King bed and twin over twin bunk bed with private bathroom
• Bedroom 8: King bed and twin over twin bunk bed with private bathroom

About Us:
At King Rentals, we’re committed to making your stay as comfortable, easy, and enjoyable as possible. As a locally owned and operated business, our friendly team is available 24/7 to help with any questions or needs during your stay. We’re here to help you relax, enjoy your time together, and create wonderful memories with your family and friends.

Key Features:
• Fully stocked kitchens with bar seating
• Spacious living rooms
• Washers & dryers
• Smart TVs & fast Wi-Fi
• Private gated parking + limited street parking
• Pack ’n Play and select amenities available upon request — please let us know in advance

Location:
Here are some nearby places of interest:
• Maggiano's Little Italy | 2 mins drive (0.3 mile)
• Stoney River Steakhouse and Grill | 3 mins drive (0.4 mile)
• BrickTop's - Nashville (West End) | 3 mins drive (0.5 mile)
• Centennial Park | 4 mins drive (0.8 mile)
• Belmont Mansion | 10 mins drive (2.1 miles)

Guest access
Guest access:
• Access codes will be provided for self-check-in.
• This home has an elevator that is not accessible for liability purposes.
• Three-level home with stairs required for access.

Other things to note
IMPORTANT – PLEASE READ BEFORE BOOKING:
• Maximum Occupancy: Maximum of 24 guests, including adults, children, and infants. No additional guests are permitted due to fire safety and insurance requirements.
• Age Requirement: All guests must be 18 or older, except children staying with their parents or guardians.
• No Parties: Parties and unauthorized gatherings are strictly prohibited. Noise complaints or law enforcement calls may result in immediate termination of the stay without a refund.
• No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited.
• No Pets: This property has a strict no-pet policy.
• Check-In/Check-Out: Check-in is at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 10:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out may be available for an additional fee starting at $60. Please message us in advance to check availability.
• Cancellations & Travel Insurance: We highly recommend purchasing travel insurance for protection against unexpected cancellations, weather, natural disasters, power outages, and other unforeseen events. We’re unable to offer refunds or rescheduled stays outside Airbnb’s Extenuating Circumstances Policy.
• Starter Supplies: We provide a starter supply of essential items. Please bring your personal toiletries and plan to purchase additional supplies if needed.
• Trash: Please place all trash in trash bags and place in the trash can outside by garage.
• Stay Connected: Follow us at @kingrentalspropertymgmt for updates.
